text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition regarding "Centennial Park Mini-Indy in the new $100 Million Master Plan for Centennial Park", submitted by Councillor Amber Morley, Ward 3 - Etobicoke-Lakeshore, containing the names of approximately 21,000 persons. 2. Petition regarding "Future Development of the Danforth", submitted by Councillor Paula Fletcher, Ward 14 - Toronto-Danforth, containing the names of approximately 886 persons.
